decisions.text: type bar: categories compared by value
values on both sides of zero: room at both ends
nominal categories sorted by value, descending
last: Total (catch-all, missing, total, then values not known)
every name fits under its bar, neighbours at least 10 pt apart: vertical bars
5 values against 7 scale labels: whichever puts fewer numbers on the chart (G2.18): the values labelled directly, the value scale and its gridlines removed, the zero line kept as the baseline
value labels as a set, one magnitude and one number of decimals, the prefix and suffix on each: $34K, $9K, $8K, −$16K, $35K (G6.16, G7.4)
every label just outside its bar's end: neither the text grey nor white reads on the bar's colour at 4.5 : 1 (G7.4, G6.5)
the unit's description on its own line above the plot: “profit per region”; the labels carry its prefix, suffix and magnitude

source.shows: the procedure of G2.18 on P1-17's data: five values against seven scale labels, so the values are labelled, a loss below its bar, and the scale goes; the darker zero line stays as the baseline (G3.7), and each label carries the currency and magnitude (G6.16)
